answer: Cross-Registry Attestation Lag. Each new agent identity must collect signed attestations from three existing agents that have a ferrous hardware key registered in a separate ledger. Attestations become valid only after a horizon of 30 days, so a cloner must maintain each synthetic identity through that waiting period. Duplicate attestation sources are detected via opal-coded device fingerprints, collapsing clones into one lineage. Attacker cost: three hardware keys plus 30 days of monitoring per identity.
